images.title: A race time of 01:48
images.purpose: Show that the race time 01:48 means 1 minute 48 seconds, drawn as a bar of 60 seconds and a bar of 48 seconds, and that 1 minute 48 seconds is 108 seconds.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a race clock display with Minutes and Seconds under it, a bar of 1 minute joined to a bar of 48 seconds under a bracket, and the sum written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption Remo's time in the race in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (40 px), left edge at x 188, about y 70. DISPLAY: one race clock display, a rounded rectangle (corner radius 24 px) 500 px wide and 170 px high, spanning x 478 to 978 and y 110 to 280, filled dark #1F2937 with a thin #2B2B2B outline, showing the digits 01:48 in white sans-serif bold (120 px) centred at x 728, y 195. Under the display, the label Minutes centred at x 628 and the label Seconds centred at x 828, both at about y 315 in dark bold (36 px). BARS: one row of exactly 2 bars directly joined, y 400 to 480, drawn at 10 px for each second. Bar 1 is teal blue #0072B2, 600 px wide (60 seconds), spanning x 188 to 788, with the white bold text 1 minute (40 px) centred inside. Bar 2 is amber #E69F00, 480 px wide (48 seconds), spanning x 788 to 1268, with the dark bold text 48 seconds (40 px) centred inside. Both bars have a dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px) and square corners. BRACKET: one thin grey #6B7280 bracket line (4 px) at y 520 from x 188 to x 1268, with a short 20 px upright end at each end pointing up. Centred under the bracket at x 728 and about y 580, the text 1 minute 48 seconds in dark bold (44 px). BOTTOM: centred at x 728 and about y 700, one line of bold dark text, 60 + 48 = 108 seconds (72 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: 01:48 is 1 minute 48 seconds, and 1 minute is 60 seconds, so it is 60 + 48 = 108 seconds.
images.description: A race clock display reading 01:48, with a bar of 1 minute joined to a bar of 48 seconds and 60 + 48 = 108 seconds written below.
images.context: Concept image for A Smaller Unit: Seconds. It follows the idea of the winners' stand boards in your maths book (minutes and seconds on a race board) and shows the concept's own example of Remo's time 01:48.
images.teaching_notes: Read the display from left to right: minutes, then seconds. The slip to watch: reading 01:48 as 148 or as 1.48.

image_decisions.why: The display and the two joined bars show that a race time is minutes and seconds, and that 1 minute is 60 seconds, which is the new unit of the chapter.
